verdict.rationale: Appwrite's first-party docs say email/password login takes "just a few lines of code" with Argon2 hashing, and that 30+ social OAuth providers (GitHub, Google, Apple, etc.) can be enabled from the Console. Its many SDKs and framework quick starts support the "in minutes" developer framing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of setup speed, and SDK-level detail showing the OAuth sign-in call flow (the OAuth evidence is Console- and marketing-level).

support.subject: As a developer, I can add email/password and social OAuth sign-in with the platform SDK in minutes

citations.quote: Email and password login with just a few lines of code secured with state of the art Argon2 hashing.
Authenticate users with existing accounts from GitHub, Google, Facebook, and 30+ other providers.
Enable 30+ social providers from the Console Social providers tab. Users sign up in one click with GitHub, Google, Apple, and the identity providers your audience already uses.
You can use one of our many SDKs or integrate directly through the REST API or GraphQL API.
